text:
Silver Price in 2018
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2018, the LBMA silver price fell 10.2% between 2018-01-31 ($17.23) and 2018-12-31 ($15.47). The highest sampled price was $17.23 in January and the lowest was $14.24 in November. The mean of these observations was $15.61. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
